Read scenes

Source: R/io.R
read-scenes.Rd

Parse a scene from a neuroglancer URL, a JSON string, a state list, a JSON file, the clipboard or a data frame of segments.

Usage

ngs_from_string(x, skip_archived = FALSE, base_url = NULL)

ngs_from_url(url, skip_archived = FALSE, base_url = NULL)

ngs_from_list(x, base_url = NULL)

ngs_from_file(path, base_url = NULL)

ngs_from_clipboard(base_url = NULL)

Arguments

x

A URL, a JSON string or a state (named list).

skip_archived

If TRUE, drop archived layers.

base_url

URL of the neuroglancer instance used by ngs_url(). If not given and the input is a URL, its base is used.

url

A neuroglancer URL.

path

Path to a JSON file.

Value

A scene.

Details

URLs pointing to a state server are supported: ?json_url=..., #!gs://..., #!https://... and #!middleauth+https://... links are fetched. CAVE state servers (e.g. FlyWire's) require a token, see ngs_cave_token().

Layers are kept exactly as written, so parsing and writing a scene round-trips it unchanged. Neuroglancer also accepts layers as a {name: layer} map; these are converted to a list.

Examples

sc <- ngs_from_string('{"layout": "3d", "layers": [{"type": "image",
  "source": "precomputed://gs://x/em", "name": "em"}]}')
sc
#> <ngs_scene> 1 layer: 1 image
#> Base URL: https://neuroglancer-demo.appspot.com/
#> 1: <image layer> "em" precomputed://gs://x/em
sc2 <- ngs_from_url(ngs_url(sc))
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ngs_from_clipboard()
} # }
